ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: If( AND( RecordType.Name = 'Parent Opportunity', $User.Bypass_VR__c = FALSE, $Profile.Name!='Xendit API Profile', $Profile.Name!='System Administrator', ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Contracting'), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(StageName)), OR( ISBLANK ( Pains_Priorities_and_Needs__c ), ISBLANK( TEXT(Has_Competitor__c) ), AND( TEXT(Has_Competitor__c) = 'Yes', ISBLANK( Primary_Competitor__c ) ), OR ( No_of_Contact_Roles__c < 1, ISBLANK( No_of_Contact_Roles__c ), LEN(Sales_Goals_Plan__c)=0, ISPICKVAl(Standard_Financial_Terms__c,''), LEN(Account.Customer_Folder_URL__c)=0, AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type,"Upsell")),LEN( Customer_Signed_Contract_URL__c)=0) ) ) ), true,false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To set stage as Contracting, make sure all fields in Discovery/Evaluation/Contracting Stage sections are filled ; there is at least one product linked to opportunity and at least 1 Contact Role has been added to the Opportunity.
